task: Generate one photorealistic still frame in the style of a casual vertical selfie video an original fictional man films of himself with his phone front camera, in his kitchen at five in the morning, to talk to his audience about the coffee he drinks every morning. It will be used as the first frame of a talking-head video, so it should feel candid and authentic, like a frame from an everyday phone video. The attached reference image is the exact coffee bag on the counter behind him: replicate it identically (same bag shape, size, materials, colors, mountain drawing, label design and label text), as described in "product".

output.look: raw, unedited iPhone front-camera video frame, not a professional photo

product.name: CUMBRE specialty ground coffee, 340 g bag (a fictional brand)
product.bag: a stand-up coffee pouch (doypack) with a flat bottom gusset, about 22 cm tall and 13 cm wide (roughly the length of an adult open hand), made of matte coffee-black paper (#16110D) with a smooth, non-glossy finish, no window, standing upright, filled and naturally creased
product.top: the top edge is heat-sealed straight across, with a thin solid copper (#C8833A) strip along the seal
product.label: printed directly on the front of the bag, centered in its upper-middle part, flat matte print, no paper sticker
product.artwork: above the text, a minimalist mountain drawn with only a few thin copper (#C8833A) lines: one continuous outline of two overlapping peaks, the taller one in the center, no fill, no shading, no sun, no other shapes
product.label_text: exactly two centered lines of text and nothing else: 'CUMBRE' in large, tall, condensed cream (#F3EBDD) sans-serif capital letters (Oswald style), and below it 'CAFÉ DE ALTURA' in small copper (#C8833A) sans-serif capital letters with wide letter spacing; no other words or numbers, and no graphics besides the thin-line mountain
product.rule: the product must look exactly like this in every image: same shape, proportions, colors, materials, mountain drawing, label design and label text

subject.identity: an original, non-famous Latin American man, 34 years old, an entrepreneur who trains every morning
subject.face: light-olive warm skin with natural texture (visible pores, slight unevenness, faint under-eye lines from waking up early), dark brown eyes, defined brows, slight natural facial asymmetry
subject.hair: short dark brown hair, slightly messy from just waking up, a few strands out of place
subject.accessories: a plain black sports watch on his left wrist, no other jewelry, no glasses
subject.build: athletic, fit build from regular training, not bulky

wardrobe.top: plain dark heather-gray cotton training t-shirt, crew neck, soft fabric, natural fabric wrinkles
wardrobe.style: ready to train, simple and functional, nothing flashy, no visible logos

pose_and_expression.position: standing at his kitchen counter, upper body leaning very slightly toward the camera
pose_and_expression.gaze: looking directly into the lens, making eye contact with the viewer
pose_and_expression.expression: calm, confident and friendly, a subtle natural half-smile, as if about to start talking; mouth closed or barely parted, relaxed jaw
pose_and_expression.hands: his right hand holds a matte black ceramic coffee mug with freshly served black coffee at chest height, fingers through the handle, a faint wisp of steam; his left hand rests relaxed on the counter edge in the lower part of the frame; fingers relaxed, all fingers anatomically correct and fully visible; nothing else in his hands
pose_and_expression.posture: shoulders relaxed and square to the camera, natural and unposed

environment.location: his modern but lived-in home kitchen at five in the morning, before sunrise
environment.background: a light wooden counter behind him with the coffee bag standing upright slightly to one side of his shoulder, label facing the camera, next to a glass French press half full of coffee; white rectangular wall tiles; a small green plant; a window in the back wall showing a deep blue pre-dawn sky; softly in focus, uncluttered
environment.foreground: the edge of the counter at the lower edge of the frame with a plate holding a half-eaten piece of toast, slightly out of focus
environment.atmosphere: tidy, real, lived-in home kitchen, quiet early morning, not a staged studio set

camera.device: iPhone front camera propped against a shelf on the counter in front of him at chest-to-eye height, slightly below eye level
camera.lens: wide-angle selfie lens (about 24mm equivalent) with its natural mild perspective
camera.framing: medium close-up from the waist up, subject centered horizontally; his head sits in the upper-middle of the frame (eyes at about 38% of the frame height from the top), leaving clean empty space above his head for on-screen graphics
camera.focus: face and mug sharp, the coffee bag label readable, background softly in focus as a phone would render it (no artificial heavy bokeh)
camera.quality: 1080x1920 vertical video frame, slight phone sensor noise, mild compression, true-to-life colors

lighting.key: soft, diffused warm-white light from a ceiling lamp and the under-cabinet lights on the cabinets directly in front of him, behind the phone, lighting his whole face evenly from the front
lighting.fill: faint cool blue pre-dawn light from the window behind him, very soft, never backlighting his face
lighting.mood: warm, calm, early-morning and realistic; both sides of the face equally lit with the same brightness and no side shadows, only very soft natural shading under the chin and nose; accurate skin tones, low contrast

realism_rules: natural and authentic, like an everyday phone video, not a stock photo
real skin texture, no smoothing, no beauty filter, no plastic or waxy skin
natural fabric folds and wrinkles on the t-shirt
correct human anatomy: two hands, five fingers each, natural proportions, a natural grip on the mug handle
realistic eyes with natural catchlights from the light in front of him
even, symmetrical illumination on the face, as when someone films himself facing the kitchen lights
the coffee bag is identical to the attached product image, at a realistic size on the counter
negative: text, captions, subtitles, logos, watermarks, UI elements; any text other than the coffee bag label (CUMBRE / CAFÉ DE ALTURA)
a different bag, a changed or blank label, a missing or different mountain drawing, misspelled label text, a second bag, extra coffee packages, text or logos on the mug
side lighting, split lighting, one half of the face darker than the other, strong shadows on one side of the face, a window beside him lighting the face from the side
studio lighting, ring light reflections, cinematic color grading, heavy bokeh
extra or deformed fingers, distorted hands, a floating or deformed mug, asymmetrical eyes, warped face
smooth or airbrushed skin, 3D render, cartoon, illustration, CGI look
suit, shirt with collar, gym equipment in the kitchen, sweat
big smile showing teeth, exaggerated expression, posing
cluttered counter, coffee machines, other people, mirrors
